name: @vesk/agentic
description: Agentic AI plugin for Vesk — zero-deps agent loop, provider abstraction, permissions, tools, checkpoints

model.description: Model name (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-2.0-flash, llama3.1)

apiKey.description: API key. Prefer env var VESK_AGENTIC_API_KEY — never commit secrets to git

baseUrl.description: Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible providers or self-hosted Ollama (e.g. http://localhost:11434)

mode.description: Default agent mode (capability-gated via Dev Server: explore=read-only, debug=controlled fixes, agent=per-capability toggles)
